name: Todoist MCP
description: Manages Todoist tasks and projects from AI assistants: add, find, reschedule and complete tasks through Todoist's hosted MCP server with OAuth.

skills.name: Add Tasks
skills.description: Adds one or more Todoist tasks to a project, section or parent task, with assignment to project collaborators.

skills.name: Find Tasks
skills.description: Finds tasks by text, project, section, label, assignee or a raw Todoist filter string, including saved filters.

skills.name: Find Tasks by Date
skills.description: Gets tasks due in a date range, with 'today' including overdue items, for daily reviews and planning.

skills.name: Reschedule Tasks
skills.description: Reschedules Todoist tasks to new dates while preserving their recurring schedules instead of wiping them.

skills.name: Productivity Stats
skills.description: Gets productivity statistics: daily and weekly completion breakdowns, goal streaks, karma score and trends.
